readonly_dependency_closure: Exactly the 82 files pinned by references.closure; all 82 rehashed unchanged this turn. Static closure is not execution/import authorization or runtime-resource completeness.
behavior: Guard both continuous and concurrent initial/repair scheduler paths before any governor reserve/charge, submission or run_one invocation. Missing/None/exception/malformed/stale/contradictory verdict holds with a stable reason; never default Ready.

Keep readiness advisory. Any future positive production dispatch must consume the existing canonical admission result bound to authenticated root/task/parent, current authority and scope, prerequisites/evidence qualification, unique accepted attempt, source/snapshot and fencing ownership. Do not mint these from Intake or goal_signature.

The selected closure supplies no verified complete production admission adapter: leave production positive admission unavailable. Explicit synthetic adapter/receipt fixtures live in the test file only; no production fake authority factory, allow-all default, environment switch or test-mode bypass.

Revalidate at the admission boundary; a local K11 budget lock cannot be presented as a cross-store or cross-process transaction. If positive runtime behavior requires a missing primitive or a third source file, stop and return the exact gap. No new authority ledger, reservation state machine, lock hierarchy, runner or lifecycle.
Report held intakes/reasons as held, not completed/source-exhausted work. Do not spin, retry UNKNOWN, or add wake/indexer/Trace/router expansion.

synthetic_acceptance.R1: Blocked prerequisite, absent/None/invalid/exception verdict: zero reserve, charge, submit and invocation in both schedulers and repair paths.
synthetic_acceptance.R2: Completed but unqualified, superseded or source-mismatched dependency remains held.
synthetic_acceptance.R4: Explicit safe synthetic admissions permit independent compatible tasks to overlap under existing K11 limits; no production overlap claim.
synthetic_acceptance.R5: Synthetic snapshot/authority invalidation before admission holds before any reserve or invocation; no claim that a mutable verdict eliminates production TOCTOU.
synthetic_acceptance.R6: Synthetic canonical adapter admits at most one incompatible attempt; scheduler never dispatches the refused one. Production atomic compatible claims remain held.
synthetic_acceptance.R7: Missing/duplicate/stale attempt or fence, quarantine, contradictory lineage and UNKNOWN acceptance hold; goal_signature alone never suffices. No real restart/nonduplication qualification.
synthetic_acceptance.R8: Existing single-goal and budget semantics retained with explicit safe fixtures for permitted runs. Default uncomposed production scheduling intentionally holds.
synthetic_acceptance.RED_and_focused: First show new denial controls fail on the pinned baseline using synthetic callbacks only; then run tests/runtime/test_scheduler.py in the owner-approved offline runner. Tests must not launch SoftLoop, Builder, providers, readiness canaries or production modules as workflows. AST import closure is not enough: stop if test setup needs external resources, installation or unadmitted effects. Actual affected-closure regression is a later integration gate; no full-suite authorization here.

budget: Proposed ceiling: one isolated source candidate, one RED and one focused GREEN run, at most one corrective focused rerun for an observed defect. Provider calls=0, paid calls=0, new formal reviews=0 within this scope. Any stricter existing cumulative ceiling wins; no reset or expansion on handoff. Stop on missing prerequisite or larger seam.
rollback: Retain base and exact candidate diff. Discard/revert only this candidate two-file diff through its owner; never reset the workspace, overwrite concurrent work or roll back shared dependencies.
integration_review: Return exact diff/hash/test receipts to Architect. Root 01a1403f-1034-74c2-95ce-bd0f705dbaef alone integrates bootstrap candidates serially against the current combined tree. The chosen older target is not a baseline replacement: kernel/ledger.py and provider_transports.py differ from combined; transfer only reviewed two-file changes and re-evaluate affected closure there. Chat1 01a147d5-525b-7e31-9fb1-80de3a325e51 remains sole D0258 integrator. Independent exact-byte review remains separately held pending 01a13075-533b-72a1-b8f8-8f109414f707 evidence of lawful privacy/$0/different-family/authority/allocation. Source construction is not review, admission or qualification.

source_authoring_basis.limited_scope: Current human instruction permits this bounded offline denial/test slice under delegated source engineering. No production, custody, runtime admission or debt repayment authority is created.

dependency_applicability.offline_port: Proposed limited source construction is a reversible default-deny boundary plus explicit synthetic tests. It neither constructs/uses D0258 custody nor supplies runtime admission. Clause 72 is preserved as an activation/composition hold, not waived or satisfied by source tests. Architect must record this bounded applicability in the issued source scope.
dependency_applicability.debt0260: DEBT-0260:103 permits compact non-applicability for a small reversible cheaply verified edit. That rationale applies only to the local denial port. Real R4/R5/R6/R7 concurrency/currentness/attempt guarantees cross authority and persistence boundaries and remain APPLICABLE under :103-106; unresolved transaction/UNKNOWN deficits block implementation of those production guarantees. Builder cannot resolve its own primitive deficit.
dependency_applicability.not_inferred: No D0258 qualification or installation is inferred from classes, source pins, tests, native messaging, or B00 review artifacts. No C2-wide D0260 exemption is asserted.

budget_counters.carry_rule: Any stricter existing cumulative ceiling prevails. No inherited attempt/UNKNOWN/provider budget reset. Stop at actual shared-account hard limit.

validity: Exact target HEAD, clean preimages and82-file read closure only. Drift, third-file need, missing primitive or exhausted bound => hold and immediate callback; no automatic expansion.
additional_safety: A generic boolean/Ready returned by a caller is not production authority. No synthetic fixture, public allow-all injection or metadata shape may grant real execution.

If safe positive-path scaffolding would require a missing canonical authority/atomic primitive, retain production denial and report that seam. Bounded synthetic positive controls remain test-only and do not discharge R4/R5/R6/R7 runtime obligations.
Do not weaken current or historical tests/findings. Current baseline tests that need permitted runs require explicit safe test fixtures within the test file.
Only the two named source/test files may change. No local factory pretending to be enrolled root, second state/runner, new module or dependency transplant.
